decisionsTitle: The members' shop: a club catalogue, orders from the members' zone, payment outside the site
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-08:** a members' shop for the club's merchandise — t-shirts, buffs, stickers — with the Administrator seeing and managing the orders. Decided then: payment outside the site (bank transfer or cash), the Administrator marks an order paid; a catalogue the club defines in «Membri» → «Magazin», with variants, an optional stock, a photo, both languages; verified members only, through the members' zone. **The owner, 2026-10-09:** «Payment is not on the site». Built while the owner was away; every routine question below was decided here and is recorded as such.

**The catalogue (backoffice).** A card «Magazin» / "Shop" on «Pagini» → «Pagini standard» → «Membri», under «Coduri de reducere», the codes' shape (§552): server actions, a question before every write the members see, a toast after, an audit row per write (`shop.product.created|saved|moved|archived|deleted`, `shop.settings_saved`) naming the row by id and never its words. A product is: the name in Română and English (both required at every save — a product with no name in one language is no product the other half of the site can show, §28, §352), a description in both or neither, a price in lei kept as integer bani (`shop_products.price_bani`, shown «45 lei», «45,50 lei»; typed «45», «45,50», «45.50»), one optional photo, the variants with an optional stock, «Vizibil în magazin», and a place in the list moved with ↑ / ↓ (the codes' and «Echipa»'s arrows, which ask nothing — the menu order of §571 is a whole-list save for a different screen).
- **The photo** reuses «Echipa»'s picture field (`TeamPhotoField`, §459, §541): upload through the shared `uploadPicture` with the quality choice, «Din galerie», the crop box starting square; the asset id and the crop's four fractions are stored as a card's are (`photo_media_asset_id`, `photo_crop`). A film's poster is refused, as for a card. A product's photo — hidden and archived products included — counts as referenced for the orphan sweep and the picture delete (`media/references.ts`) and is listed on the pictures page as used on the members' page, which is the screen that holds the shop (no new reference kind).
- **Variants** are one box, one per line — «S», «M: 10», «XL: 0» — the label (at most 20 characters, unique without regard to case, at most 20 lines) and, after a colon, the stock; no number is no limit. An empty box is the product's one variant, its stock in the «Stoc» box. Every product has at least one variant row (`shop_product_variants`, `label` null for the one). A dynamic list of rows would have needed a client island; one box of lines needs none.
- **A stock the Administrator did not touch is not overwritten.** The form carries the stock it loaded per variant; on save, a number equal to what was loaded keeps the stock as it stands now (`stockToSave`), so an order placed while the form was open is never undone by a save that did not change the number. A changed number is written as typed.
- **Delete or archive.** A product no order names is deleted; one with any order — cancelled ones included — is archived (`archived_at`, hidden): it leaves the shop and the editor's list, its row stays for the orders' product filter, and every order keeps its own copy of the titles, the label and the price.

**Roles.** `canManageShop` — the Administrator and the Superadministrator — writes the catalogue, the settings and every verb on an order (an order is money the club collects, the threshold of changing a registration). `canReadShop` = `canReadRegistrations` (§289): the Organizer reads the card, the orders and the CSV and is offered no verb. The Redactor and the Tehnic, who open the Membri page for its texts, get no part of the shop — not even a count; a volunteer and a member nothing. Every action asserts a staff session at the door and every service asserts the capability again (BR-REQ-060-01). The ordering member's address appears beside an order and in the CSV only for `canSeeShopMemberAddresses` = `canSendNewsletter` — §550's readers of addresses — which is today the same set as the shop's readers; written as its own rule so the two can move apart.

**Ordering (members' zone).** `/ro/zona-membri` gains «Magazinul clubului» and «Comenzile mele». The door is the zone's own: the account (`getCurrentAccount`, `canOpenMembersZone`), the club's member accounts of §524 and §662 — a live row on «Echipa» is a verified member — never a staff-only door and never a participant account (AGENTS.md §10.3). Each visible product shows its photo, name, price, description, a variant select (a sold-out variant shown disabled with «— stoc epuizat», never a stock number), a quantity of 1 to 5, an optional note of at most 300 characters and «Comandă». Plain forms and native controls drawn on the server, no client island, 44-pixel targets; the zone answers with one code in the address (`?shop=placed|cancelled|CONFLICT|…`, a closed set) turned into a sentence, never anything typed.
- **An order** (`shop_orders`) is the member's account, the member's name copied, the language, the product and the variant, a copy of both titles, the label and the unit price at the moment of the order, the quantity, the note, a number for people («Comanda nr. 12», an identity column), the status `PLACED` → `PAID` → `HANDED_OVER` or `CANCELLED`, the moments, and who cancelled (`MEMBER` or `CLUB`, and the account). One product line per order.
- **Never oversold.** The product row is share-locked first and the variant row then locked (`SELECT … FOR UPDATE`) in the order's own transaction — product then variant, the order every writer takes, so a delete that counts the product's orders and an order on it queue rather than deadlock, and no order lands on a product just deleted; orders share the product's lock with each other — its stock checked and lowered there, the order written in the same commit; an order larger than what is left is refused whole (CONFLICT), never filled in part. A check constraint keeps the stock from going below zero whatever the code does. A cancellation gives back exactly what the order took (`stock_taken`), under the same lock, once. **Every writer takes the same locks in the same order — product, then variant, then order.** An order placed share-locks the product and locks the variant; a save updates the product, locks its variants and deletes one no longer listed, whose `ON DELETE SET NULL` then writes the orders naming it; a delete locks the product and cascades the same way. A move of an order (paid, handed over, cancelled) therefore reads the order's product and variant ids unlocked, share-locks the product, locks the variant, and only then locks the order and checks its status and ids again: locking the order first and the variant after, to give stock back, closed a cycle with a save removing that variant (a 40P01 deadlock, answered as a 500). A variant deleted in between leaves the order with no variant id and nothing to give back to; an id changed to anything but null is a CONFLICT. `tests/concurrency/shop-stock.test.ts` races ten members for the last unit on ten connections (one order, nine refusals, stock 0) and two cancellations of one order (the stock back once); the PGlite suite proves the guard sequentially.
- **One press, one order.** «Comandă» and the member's «Anulează comanda» are the site's pending button (`SubmitButton`, `useFormStatus`): while the request is in flight the button says so («Se trimite comanda…», «Se anulează comanda…») and holds a second press. The server does not rely on it: an order identical to one the same member placed in the last ten seconds (`ORDER_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS`) — the same variant, quantity and note, not cancelled — is answered with that order as a success, read inside the order's transaction after the locks, so a repeat racing the first waits on the variant's lock and then finds it. Nothing is taken, audited or emailed twice. A different note or quantity is a different order; a cancelled order is no repeat; after ten seconds the same order is wanted twice and is placed twice. `tests/concurrency/shop-stock.test.ts` presses twice at once on two connections and finds one order.
- **Transitions** (`domain.ts#nextOrderStatus`): paid and handed over by the club only, handed over only once paid — cash at the run is two presses, «Marchează plătită» then «Marchează predată», which keeps "paid" a fact on its own; cancelled by the member only while `PLACED` (once the club has the money, the member writes to the club), by the club any time before the hand-over (a refund is outside the site, as the payment); a handed-over or cancelled order is closed. A member's cancel names only their own orders: another member's id is "no such order".
- **A member's cancel asks in words, not in a dialog**: a fold «Vreau să anulez comanda» with one sentence and the button — the public site carries no confirm island (the backoffice's `ActionForm` stays the backoffice's).
- **«Comenzile mele»** lists the member's orders newest first with their status, and under every order still `PLACED` the club's payment words; it is drawn whenever the member has orders, the shop open or not — an order placed stays the member's to read.

**Payment outside the site.** One setting on the card, «Cum se plătește» — plain text in both languages or neither (the club's IBAN, «sau numerar la alergare») — shown under every unpaid order in the zone and in the confirmation email; and «Cine primește comenzile», one address or none. Both are one `platform_settings` row (`membersShop`, no migration), audited by shape only. The site never takes, stores or processes card data; there is no payment provider; a price is a number the member reads, never a sum the platform charges.

**Emails** (the outbox, BR-REQ-080-02: queued in the order's own transaction). Three types, `email_message_type` + `SHOP_ORDER_PLACED` («Comanda ta a fost primită», to the member's account address), `SHOP_ORDER_PAID` («Comanda ta e plătită», queued by «Marchează plătită»; none when the account is gone) and `SHOP_ORDER_CLUB_NOTICE` (one per order to «Cine primește comenzile», none without an address — the list alone). The payload is the order's id; the facts are read at the send from the order's own copy: a bold line «Comanda nr. 12: Tricou — M × 2 — 90 lei», and after the body, whoever wrote it, the payment words (on the confirmation) and the note — the platform's lines, as §547's are, so a club that rewrites the words in «Setări» → «Emailuri» keeps them. The member's button opens the zone, the club's the card's orders, both from `APP_BASE_URL`. No token. Their audience is `staff` (a member's account and the club's own mailbox, about no registration): no club copy, no privacy line (the confirmation's body names the zone; the notice names the shop), no «Nu mai pot ajunge», not waited for on a public page; the member's two on the confirmations' road, the club's on the club's. The `[QA]` tag comes with the outbox, as for every type. The editor's closed placeholder set is untouched: the three fill none of its fields.

**The orders list (backoffice).** A fold «Comenzi · N» in the card, opening by itself while a filter is in use: a GET filter by status and product whose state is the address (§527's shape), each order with its number, status, the member's name (and address, for §550's readers), the product, the variant, the quantity, the total, the date and the note; «Marchează plătită», «Marchează predată», «Anulează» — only the verbs that may follow, each asked first, each audited (`shop.order.paid|handed_over|cancelled`). Each verb posts the list's filter back as hidden fields, read again through the address's own parser (a status from the closed set, a product id that is a UUID, anything else dropped), and the answer lands on the same list, filtered, its fold open. The card shows the newest 500 (`ORDERS_SHOWN_MAX`); «Comenzi · N» is the filter's counted total, never the rows drawn, and past the limit one line says so («Se văd cele mai noi 500 din 734. CSV-ul le are pe toate.»). «Descarcă CSV» (`GET /api/admin/shop/orders`, `canReadShop` asserted in the route) downloads the whole filter, the registrations export's rules (every cell through `csvCell`, a BOM, CRLF, ISO dates), the address column only for §550's readers, recorded as `shop.orders_exported` with the filter's shape and the row count, never a name. An account removed from «Echipa» leaves its orders with the name and without the address («contul nu mai există»).

**Privacy and the gate** (the §562 / §613 pattern). The privacy notice's template gains, at the end of section 5, a paragraph naming the shop through a new marker, `{{membersShop}}` — filled with the zone section's own name, quoted («„Magazinul clubului”» / «“The club's shop”», from `Members.shop.title`): what an order keeps (the member's account and name, the product, variant, quantity, price, the note, the status and its moments; the address from the account), why (performing the order, art. 6(1)(b); what must be kept as accounting records, the club's legal obligation, art. 6(1)(c)), that payment is outside the site and no card data is handled, how long (until the hand-over, then as long as the law requires for accounting records; a removed account leaves the order with the name and no address), and who sees it (the club's organizers and administrators). Until a notice naming it is in force in every language (`noticeDescribesMembersShop`, read per request behind the account), the zone draws no shop and `placeOrder` refuses; `/admin/tasks` carries the row `shopNotice` while a product is visible and the notice is silent (done once it names the shop; absent while the shop is empty and the notice silent); the card says so in a banner; the legal editor's token legend lists the marker. Every page that renders a legal text merges its value. The notice's length ceiling in `merge-fields.test.ts` moves by this paragraph.

**Schema.** One expand-only migration, `0133_members_shop`: `shop_products`, `shop_product_variants` (stock nullable, check ≥ 0), `shop_orders` (the copies, status enum `shop_order_status`, timestamps, member id `ON DELETE SET NULL`, `cancelled_by` checked to `MEMBER`/`CLUB`, quantity checked 1–5, note ≤ 300), indexes on the status, the creation time, the member and the product; and the three message types. Nothing renamed or dropped.

**Decided here, for the owner to overturn:** the Redactor reads nothing of the shop (the brief named the Organizer as reader and the Tehnic as excluded; the Redactor is neither); a hand-over needs a paid order first; a member may not cancel a paid order; the club's cancel of a paid order sends no email (the club tells the member, and refunds, outside the site); the member's name is copied onto the order so the accounting record survives the account; the club's notice is written in Romanian (the club's language); the product's display order is arrows, not a number; a sold-out variant is shown disabled, never with a count.

**Owed, and said:** the platform deletes no order by itself yet — the accounting period in years is the lawyer's to name before a retention step is written, and the order rows are years away from it; the guide («Ghid») has no shop steps yet; SETUP.md §43 is the club's procedure.

**Refused.** Payment on the site (the owner's decision: no card form, no payment provider, nothing to keep under PCI). A cart with several products in one order: one product line per order keeps the stock rule, the statuses and the emails one thing each — a member who wants two products orders twice. Orders from anybody but a member account: no public shop, no participant account. Shipping: hand-over in person. A client island for the order form or a dynamic variants editor: native controls and one box of lines do the same with no script.
changelogLine: - **«Magazin» — the members' shop** — the club's merchandise in the members' zone: an Administrator keeps the catalogue on «Membri» → «Magazin» (both languages, a price in lei, variants with an optional stock, a photo), a member orders one product at a time and sees «Comenzile mele», payment happens outside the site and the Administrator marks it paid, handed over or cancelled; a double tap on «Comandă» is one order, three emails, a CSV, and the shop stays closed until the privacy notice names it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The members' shop's catalogue, payment words, orders' recipient and every verb on an order («Marchează plătită», «Marchează predată», «Anulează») are the Administrator's and the Superadministrator's alone, asserted in the service; the Organizer reads the card, the orders and the CSV and is offered no verb; the Redactor, the Tehnic, a volunteer and a member read and write nothing of it; a member orders and cancels only through their own account in the members' zone, and another member's order is no such order to them (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a variant with a stock, when members order it, then the variant row is locked in the order's own transaction, an order larger than what is left is refused whole and nothing is taken, ten simultaneous orders for the last unit on ten connections yield exactly one order and a stock of zero, and a cancellation — by the member while placed, by the club until the hand-over — gives back exactly what the order took, once, even when pressed twice at once; the same member placing the same variant, quantity and note again within ten seconds of an order not cancelled is answered with that order, and nothing is taken, audited or sent twice, even when both presses race on two connections; a move of an order locks the product, the variant and then the order — the order a save that deletes a variant takes — so a cancellation racing such a save never deadlocks (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

An order keeps its own copy of the product's titles, the variant's label and the unit price; a product that any order names is archived instead of deleted; a save that leaves a variant's stock as loaded keeps the stock as it stands, so an order placed meanwhile is not undone; the ordering member's address is shown beside an order and written in the orders' CSV only for the roles that read members' addresses (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Placing an order queues «Comanda ta a fost primită» to the member's account address with the order on its bold line and the club's payment words and the note after the body, and one notice to «Cine primește comenzile» when an address is set; marking it paid queues «Comanda ta e plătită»; none carries a token, a club copy or the participant's privacy line, and each button is built from `APP_BASE_URL` (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Until a privacy notice naming `{{membersShop}}` is in force in every language, the members' zone draws no shop and an order is refused; the platform's template names it at the end of section 5 with what an order keeps, why, for how long and that payment is outside the site; `/admin/tasks` carries `shopNotice` open while a product is visible and the notice is silent, and the legal editor's legend lists the marker (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The orders list on «Magazin» counts every order its filter names in «Comenzi · N», draws the newest 500 and says in one line when more exist (the CSV carries them all), and a verb pressed on a filtered list answers on the same filter, its fold open; a posted filter value outside the closed set of statuses or not a product id is dropped (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
